subject: And once again: Problem with deployment

messages.author: 6b2ec59cb9e6d3a2
messages.subject: And once again: Problem with deployment
parts:
Hi,

Forgive me if this should be quite an easy question, but I am really new to Shiny.

Well, I have written an App and it all works perfectly fine on my computer. Now, I wanted to deploy it, but every time I try, I see the following error:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 149647...DONE
Deploying bundle: 671607 for application: 149647 ...
Waiting for task: 324347566
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 661669
  error: Building package: zlibbioc
################################ Begin Task Log ################################
################################# End Task Log #################################
Fehler: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 324347568 failed: Error building image: Error fetching zlibbioc (1.20.0) source. Error downloading package source. Please update your BioConductor packages to the latest version and try again: <BioconductorPackageSource rep
Ausführung angehalten


I installed the package "zlibbioc" and updated all possible packages, but it did not help. Actually, I am not using zlibbioc...but I suppose it is necessary for the App?

It would be really great if anybody could help me!

Many thanks in advance,

Sarah

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: And once again: Problem with deployment
parts:
From what I can tell, zlibbioc is pulled in as a dependency of another package you are using. 1.20.0 is available with Bioconductor 3.4, but you appear to have been using 3.2, for which zlibbioc 1.16.0 is available.

Hope that helps.
